# Resume Conversation… (⌘⇧O): the conversations agents' hooks recorded
# (tests/run.sh writes one into the data folder). Picking
# one opens a tab there whose shell types the agent's resume command (no
# claude on this PATH: the shell says so, after the command it was given).
key:cmd+shift+o
wait:0.6
expect-palette:fix-login
key:enter
wait:7
expect-tab-count:2
expect:claude --resume 13b9c2e4-probe
expect-tab:fix-login
